verdict.rationale: Auth0 docs describe federating an existing enterprise directory so employees can sign in to internal and third-party apps with their enterprise credentials. Enterprise SSO is listed as a supported login method, SAML-based authentication is referenced, and enterprise customers can configure SSO and sync via SCIM or Google Workspace. Organizations add per-business federated login flows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SAML and OIDC enterprise connection setup, named Okta and Entra ID connectors, and independent or hands-on corroboration of workforce federation.
